labels.compute_window: DERIVED (sampler end minus the arm's own perf_counter studies and batched-score walls)
labels.gpu_note: squidpy and lifelines never touch the GPU; the A100 is only the container class
labels.cpu_note: per-core % from /proc/stat of the container (what psutil reads). gVisor shows 24 cores and spreads the container's use evenly over them, so only the total is meaningful: cores busy = sum / 100 (8 reserved, bursts can borrow more). nvidia-smi utilization.gpu is NVML's busy-kernel share over its own sample period (note revised after the run, at the replay commit; the data are unchanged)

arms.gpu: bench/design_batch.run_arm('gpu'), one process on the A100

cost.basis: 3 containers x local wall 219 s x $2.9876/h (upper bound: includes image pull and queueing)
